questions.question: Which among the following is not an example of emulsion?
questions.solution: Emulsion is a type of colloidal solution in which both dispersion phase and dispersion medium are in a liquid state. Milk, butter, chocolate milk, cookie dough and whipped cream water in benzene and cream are some common examples of emulsion. Curds on the other hand are a dairy product obtained by coagulating milk in a process called curdling.

questions.question: 'Nor westers' are thunderstorms which are prominent in ________.
questions.solution:
Nor westers or the Kalbaishakhi is a local thunderstorm and rainfall which occurs in India and Bangladesh.

Kalbaishakhi occurs from March till monsoon establishes over North-East India. Odisha, West Bengal, Assam, Bihar, Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, Bangladesh, and North-Eastern states of India are affected by violent thunderstorms during this period.

Kal Baisakhi originates in the Chhotanagpur Plateau, in and around the cities of Ranchi and Jamshedpur. In times of incursion of moist air in these elevated regions, amidst high temperatures, these extremely destructive thunderstorms occur.

Kal Baisakhi definitely brings destruction in terms of lightning, thunderstorm, hailstorm, and rainfall. However, it is extremely helpful for pre-Kharif crops like jute, paddy, and a large number of vegetables and fruits. It gives the much-desired relief after mid-day heat and pours well on the thirsty soil for the development of crops.

questions.question: Which of the following is the largest mammal?
questions.solution: The blue whale (Balaenoptera musculus) is a marine mammal which is the largest mammal in the world. It belongs to the suborder of baleen whales. At 30 meters (98 ft.) in length and 180 metric tons in weight, it is the largest known mammal to have ever existed.

questions.question: Netscape Navigator is a ________.
questions.solution: Netscape Navigator is a web browser which has been discontinued. questions.question: What is nature of pH of Milk?
questions.solution: Milk is slightly acidic as it has a pH of around 6.5 to 6.7. According to some sources milk is cited as neutral since it is so close to the neutral pH of 7.0.

questions.question: Who among the following devised the technique IVF (In vitro Fertilization)?
questions.solution: Robert G. Edwards devised the technique IVF. He was awarded the Nobel Prize in Physiology in 2010. He co-developed the treatment together with Patrick Steptoe. In vitro fertilization (IVF) is a process of fertilization where an egg is combined with sperm outside the body, in vitro.

questions.question: 'Wimbledon' is a place associated with which of the following sports?
questions.solution: The Championships, Wimbledon, also known simply as Wimbledon, is the oldest and the most prestigious tennis tournament in the world. It has been held at the All England Club in Wimbledon, London, since 1877 and is played on outdoor grass courts.

questions.question: Medium-term loans are provided for a period of ________.
questions.solution: Medium term loans are loans where repayments are made over a period of between one and three years. The short term loan is basically for less than a year and the long-term loan can be repaid within a time limit of 20 - 30 years.

questions.question: Under which article, President of India can proclaim financial emergency?
questions.solution: Under Article 360 if the President realizes that there is an economic situation in which the financial stability or credit of India is threatened, he/she can declare a financial emergency in the country. This type of an emergency must be approved by the Parliament generally within two months.

questions.question: What is the SI unit of temperature?
questions.solution:
**__Explanation__:**

**Celsius scale:**

__
 
• In this scale, a **lower fixed point (ice point)** is taken **0°** and the **upper fixed point** **(steam point)** is taken **100°**.
 
• The **temperature measured** on **this scale** all in **degree celsius (°C)**.

**Fahrenheit scale:**

 
• This scale of temperature has a **lower fixed point** at **32° F** and an **upper fixed point** at **212° F**.
 
• The **change in temperature of 1° F** corresponds to a **change of less than 1° on the Celsius scale**.

**Kelvin scale:**

 
• The **Kelvin temperature scale** is also known as the **thermodynamic scale**. The **triple point of water** is also selected to be the **zero of the scale of temperature**.
 
• The temperatures measured on this scale are **in Kelvin (K)**.
 
• The **S.I unit** of **temperature** is **Kelvin**.

**Note:__**

 
• The **Kelvin** is the **primary unit of temperature** but is often used in **conjunction with the Celsius degree**, which has the same magnitude. Therefore option 1 is correct.
 
• The definition implies that **absolute zero (0 K)** is equivalent to **−273.15 °C**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2c35f77405f2cdff3137f5b58b81f46dbe2ceae13baf74dacb1ddf00458f063a.png] 

All these temperatures are related to each other by the following relationship:

frac{{F - 32}}{9} = (C)/(5) = frac{{K - 273}}{5}

questions.question: UV rays coming from Sun, majorly causes which cancer?
questions.solution: UV radiation from the sun is the main factor that causes skin cells to become cancer cells. Too much UV radiation from the sun or other sources such as Solaria (solariums, sunbeds, and sun lamps) are the major reason behind all skin cancers.

questions.question: Himalayan mountain range falls under which type of mountains?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Fold Mountain**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Himalayan mountain range is basically the** Fold Mountains**.
 
• It formed as a result of the **collision between the Indian Plate and Eurasian Plate,** which began 50 million years ago and continues today.
 
• Fold Mountains occur near **convergent** or **compressional plate** **boundaries**.
 
• Some of the Examples of Fold Mountains are the **Alps, Rockies, Andes, **and** Himalayas**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b7e75026cdf7e84974f6cada6ca5ad38ef37f5bea3aa26fed0d45de5d96b9066.png] 

 
• The **Himalayas**, a great mountain system of Asia, forming a barrier between the Plateau of Tibet to the north and the alluvial plains of the Indian subcontinent to the south.
 
• The Himalayas include the **highest mountains** in the world, with more than **110 peaks rising to elevations** of 24,000 feet (7,300 meters) or more above sea level.

questions.question: What is the full form of RNA?
questions.solution:
The full form of RNA is Ribonucleic Acid. There are 3 types of RNA, each encoded by its own type of gene:

 
• mRNA - Messenger RNA-Encodes amino acid sequence of a polypeptide.
 
• tRNA - Transfer RNA- Brings amino acids to ribosomes during translation.
 
• rRNA - Ribosomal RNA-With ribosomal proteins, makes up the ribosomes, the organelles that translate the mRNA.

questions.question: In which year (in AD) was the East India Company established?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **__1600__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Governor and company of merchants of London trading into the East Indies, popularly known as the English East India Company, were formed in 1600 AD.
 
• Captain William Hawkins arrived at Jahangir’s court (1609 AD) to seek permission to open a factory in Surat. A Farman was issued by Jahangir, permitting the English to build a factory in Surat (1613 AD).
 
• Sir Thomas Roe visited Jahangir’s court (1615 AD) as an ambassador of King James I to seek permission to trade in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Dutch East India Company established factories in India at Masulipatnam in 1605 AD, Pulicat (1610 AD), Surat (1616 AD), Bimlipatam (1641 AD), and Karaikal (1645 AD).
 
• The French East India Company was formed in 1664 AD by *Colbert *under state patronage during the reign of Louis XIV.

questions.question: At which of the following place, the weight of an object is maximum?
questions.solution:
**__CONCEPT__:**

**Weight:**

__
 
• The **weight of an object** is defined as the **force of gravity on the object** and may be calculated as the **mass times the acceleration of gravity**, i.e.,

W = mg

Where m = mass of the object and g = acceleration due to gravity

 
• Since the **weight is a force**, so its **SI unit** is the **Newton**.

EXPLANATION__:

 
• Acceleration due to gravity at the surface of the earth is given by:

Rightarrow g = frac{{GM}}{{{R²}}}

 
• As Earth is elliptical in shape i.e., it is flattened at the poles and bulged out at the equator, due to which the equatorial radius is about 21 km longer than the polar radius.
 
• As the polar radius is smaller than the equatorial radius, therefore the acceleration due to gravity is maximum at poles and minimum at the equator. 
 
• As we know the **weight of an object** is equal to the **mass times the acceleration of gravity **i.e., **w = mg**.
 
• As acceleration due to gravity is maximum at poles and minimum at the equator, therefore **weight of the object** will be **maximum at poles**. Hence option 1 is correct.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fe6d8e50e4593a64912878e3c15916d9d2f96f114503286f78875e506d63d603.png] 

 
 

 
 
Mass

 
 
 
Weight

 
 
 

 
 
Mass of a body is the measure of its inertia, greater the mass of the body greater will be the inertia.

 
 
 
The weight of a body at any place is the product of its mass and gravitational acceleration at that place.

 
W = mg

 
 
 

 
 
Mass of the body always remains constant.

 
 

 
 
 
The weight of the body can slightly vary from place to place on the earth.

 
 

 
 
 

 
 
Its value can never be zero for any material particle.

 
 
 
At the pole, the weight of the body is maximum, whereas, at the equator, it is minimum.

questions.question: Which country has banned 'Facebook'?
questions.solution: Facebook was blocked in China following the July 2009 Urumqi riots because Facebook was used as a part of the communications network by the Xinjiang independence activist. As informed by the "Blocked in China" website, Facebook is still blocked even there have been reports of Facebook being partially unblocked in China as in Hong Kong and Macau Facebook is not blocked.

questions.question: Which of the following is a feature of Federal Government?

options.text: Division of powers between federal and state Government

questions.solution:
In a federal government, there should be a clear division of power between federal and state Government so that the units and the center are required to enact and legislate within their sphere of activity and none violates its limits and tries to encroach upon the functions of others. Some of the other features of Federal Government are:

 
• Written Constitution
 
• Supremacy of the Constitution
 
• Rigid Constitution
 
• Independent Judiciary
 
• Bicameral Legislature

questions.question: Which of the following rate is charged by banks to their most creditworthy customers?
questions.solution: The prime lending rate is the rate at which banks lend to their most creditworthy customers, including large corporations. It is often used as a benchmark for other loans like credit card and small-business loans.
